lines.text: After giving the deed to Baruch son of Neriah, Jeremiah prays that God made the heavens and the earth.
God brought Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders and gave them the land He swore to their fathers.
God says Pharaoh king of Egypt will capture the city, and the Chaldeans will set it on fire.
The people built Baal's high places in the Valley of Ben-hinnom and made their children pass through fire to Chemosh.
Fields will be bought with silver in the land of Benjamin because God will restore them from captivity.
